run_qlib_data_preprocess: run the QlibDataPreprocessor to load, process, and split financial data into train, val, and test sets
initialize_qlib_environment: initialize the Qlib environment with a custom data path and CN region configuration
load_qlib_financial_data: load raw OHLCV financial data from Qlib for multiple symbols and compute derived features
split_dataset_train_val_test: split loaded financial data into train, validation, and test sets by time ranges and save as pickle files
filter_symbols_insufficient_data: filter out symbols with insufficient data length relative to lookback and predict windows
